page.overview:
Who is Dwelma?

Before the battle at Glory Run Road, Keg described Dwelma as the "creepiest and the craziest" of the Iron Shepherds, as well as "pretty gnarly" to the remaining Mighty Nein.

A group of dark figures (likely Dwelma, Protto, Ruzza, and Wohn) attacked Fjord, Jester, and Yasha when they moved away from the rest of the Mighty Nein camping for the night. The attack made no noise. After a struggle, Fjord, Jester, and Yasha were all bound and gagged. The Iron Shepherds dragged them to Lorenzo to show off their catches then locked them in cages. The carts with the cages continued along the road.

Beau, Caleb, Keg, Molly, and Nott ambushed the Iron Shepherds on the Glory Run Road. Beau and Molly surrounded Dwelma when they came out of hiding and attacked her. Dwelma helped her allies by dispelling Caleb's Slow spell, but was still knocked unconscious by Beau. No one revived Dwelma and she bled out. The Iron Shepherds put her body on one of their carts after the battle and took her with them.

Keg mentions to the Mighty Nein that Dwelma has "... a weird liking for Lorenzo." and to be ready if Lorenzo goes down first as Dwelma will become very hostile.
